describes: Current text-selection markup, caret, replacement and preview.

cases.name: highlight-by-drag
cases.covers: A real text-select drag commits current per-line quads with tool defaults, clears selection and can author squiggly from a later selection.

cases.name: insert-and-replace-text
cases.covers: Insertion anchors to the end glyph; replacement previews strikeout and atomically creates a grouped Caret+StrikeOut pair.

cases.name: replace-text-anchors-at-the-end-glyph
cases.covers: The replacement caret uses the final glyph cell instead of a taller first glyph segment.

cases.name: create-from-selection-anchors-at-the-end-glyph
cases.covers: The public text-selection create uses the same final glyph anchor and resolves the primary record.

cases.name: replace-text-across-pages
cases.covers: Replacement authors a separate atomic group per page, anchoring non-end pages to the final segment and end page to its glyph.

cases.name: preview-follows-the-tool
cases.covers: During an active text gesture, tool switches change markup preview and highlight visibility; switching after the gesture instead authors the selected text.

cases.name: markup-from-selection
cases.covers: The current host bridge returns false for no selection and true after creating one markup per selected page; it clears the text selection.

cases.name: create-from-selection-text-edits
cases.covers: The public authoring door resolves records, supports clear:false and creates replacement groups independently on both selected pages.

cases.name: markup-needs-a-selection-plugin-and-authority
cases.covers: The host bridge is inert without selection or create authority; direct host markup creation is gated while pure previews remain available.
